top_reforms.reform: Post-GFC fiscal consolidation & banking sector restructuring (2010–2015)
top_reforms.description: €67bn IMF/EU bailout; NAMA bad bank created; five bank recapitalisations; €30bn fiscal consolidation over 6 years; water charges controversy.
top_reforms.outcome: Ireland exited programme 2013 — fastest euro area recovery; primary surplus by 2014; 10yr bond yields normalised by 2015.
